svg.text: Figure 9.3. The state record: 68 words of 128 bits, one format for the host, the Tracer and the replayer
v1.3 (DECISIONS-v1.3 §23, §24; DECISIONS-v1.26 items 1, 2, 8, 12; spec §4.19.2) — byte offsets 0x000–0x43F of the region; narrow fields widened, not to scale
words 4–64 (0x040–0x40F): registers 4–125, two to a word, not shown
template bitmap: bit i set if the window used controller-fed inline template i
at done n: window n+1's start (to tile n+1)
at done n: run n's totals (to tile n)
proposed: suggested, not yet ruled on
the pc at the window's first row; live while the Tracer runs
that row's index in the committed bytecode; live
the rows of the first instruction's expansion already run
v1.25's compression flags: written 0 and ignored, never reused
per pass: store rows pop the write log (the Tracer ignores it)
per pass: output rows carry rd's value before the row
code, read log, write log: 128-bit words as sent, padding included
each stream raw (0) or through set 2 (1): set 1's choice
code, read log, write log: the values each stream decodes to
advice words left: the segment's size at load, counting down live
the Tracer; C&C 3 at the end
0; the advice field's candidate home (SP1's call)
word 2 + i: register 2i in [63:0], 2i + 1 in [127:64]; the live register file
root and depth of the Tracer's copy of the start image (.pages)
root and depth of the proof's jump-target map
the proof's K and layout, in 4 KB units: the range check, the .pages offset
bit i: the window used controller-fed inline template i
At done n the record is read out in place, as output queue 0: words 0 and 2–66 are window n+1's start, sent to tile n+1; word 1's three output fields and word 67
are run n's totals, sent to tile n with its three streams. Nothing writes a state between runs. Word 1's advice field counts down live across the segment's 64 runs:
a pop past 0 is the advice-underflow error, and C&C 3 checks it reads 0 after the 64th done. The replayer ignores words 66 and 67 and word 1's advice field.
Frame 2 of the segment file takes the same layout (§23).
The state record is one format from the host through the Tracer to the replayers: 68 words of 128 bits at byte offsets 0x000–0x43F, loaded state word first,
whose write resets the unit. It is the Tracer's working state, so at each done it is read out in place: purple fields are window n+1's start, blue fields run n's totals.
Word 66's fields and the advice field are proposed: their bit positions are SP1's to place.
Source: planning/DECISIONS-v1.3.md (to 7374646) §3, §13, §23, §24; DECISIONS-v1.26.md items 1, 2, 8, 12; spec/machine-spec.md §4.19.2, §4.19.5. Review: WORKER24/NOTES.md.
